items.q: What does Green Plus EXIM export?
items.a: Fresh fruits and vegetables, grains and rice, pulses, spices, fish and seafood, animal feed ingredients, fertilizers and organic manure, plus other Indian export categories on request.

items.q: Where is Green Plus EXIM based?
items.a: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, with sourcing relationships across India's producing regions.

items.q: How long has Green Plus EXIM been trading?
items.a: Since 2000 — over 25 years.

items.q: Do you sell to individual consumers?
items.a: No — we supply importers, distributors, wholesalers, retail chains, manufacturers/processors and trading companies at export volumes.

items.q: What registrations do you hold?
items.a: IEC (Import Export Code) and APEDA registration. See our Registrations page for details.

items.q: How do I request a quote?
items.a: Use the Get a Quote form, or send your product, quantity and destination via WhatsApp.

items.q: How fast will I get a response?
items.a: Within 24 business hours.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: Our default MOQ is 1 x 20ft container; trial orders are discussed on a per-product basis.

items.q: Can I order a trial quantity before committing to a full container?
items.a: Yes, for most products — ask when you send your requirement.

items.q: Do prices change?
items.a: Yes — commodity and shipping prices move regularly. Quotes carry a validity window; request a current quote rather than relying on an old one.

items.q: Can you supply on a repeat/contract basis?
items.a: Yes — monthly, quarterly or annual supply arrangements can be discussed. See Private Label & Bulk Supply.

items.q: Can I get samples before ordering?
items.a: Yes, for most products, subject to season and availability. See our Sample Policy.

items.q: How do I know what grade/specification I'll receive?
items.a: Specifications are confirmed in writing before production or procurement begins, based on your requirement.

items.q: Do specifications vary by season?
items.a: For fresh produce, yes — grade and availability follow harvest calendars. See each product page's availability calendar.

items.q: Can you supply custom packaging or private label?
items.a: Yes for many products — see Packaging & Labelling and Private Label & Bulk Supply.

items.q: How is your organic manure described?
items.a: We use 'organic manure' and 'organic fertilizer' as product-type descriptions, not as certification claims.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Letter of Credit (LC), advance payment / Cash Against Documents (CAD), and Telegraphic Transfer (TT). See Payment Terms.

items.q: Do you require full payment in advance?
items.a: It depends on order size and relationship — first orders often use LC or a partial advance; terms are agreed per order.

items.q: Which currency do you invoice in?
items.a: Typically USD; other currencies can be discussed.

items.q: Which ports do you ship from?
items.a: Nhava Sheva (JNPT), Mundra, Chennai, Kolkata, Kochi and Visakhapatnam, plus air cargo for time-sensitive orders.

items.q: Do you use reefer containers?
items.a: Yes, for fresh produce and frozen seafood.

items.q: Which Incoterms do you support?
items.a: FOB, CIF, CFR and EXW. See Logistics & Shipping for details.

items.q: How long does shipping take to my country?
items.a: It varies by region — see the transit-time table on Logistics & Shipping, or ask for an estimate to your specific port.

items.q: Can you ship less than a full container?
items.a: Mostly we ship FCL, but a trial LCL quantity can be discussed for some products.

items.q: Who handles import customs clearance?
items.a: That's typically the buyer's responsibility or their customs broker's, unless otherwise agreed.

items.q: What documents come with a shipment?
items.a: Export documentation prepared to match destination-country and buyer requirements — phytosanitary certificate, certificate of origin, fumigation certificate, lab test reports and more, as applicable.

items.q: Can you arrange third-party inspection?
items.a: Yes — SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek or your nominated agency can be arranged on request.

items.q: Do you provide lab test reports?
items.a: Yes, on request, for moisture, admixture, residue and other relevant tests.

items.q: How do I know what documentation my country requires?
items.a: Share your compliance checklist and we will confirm the documentation for your shipment. See also our country-specific market pages for regulatory overviews.

items.q: What industry certifications do you hold?
items.a: We hold IEC and APEDA registration. We don't hold or claim other industry certifications.

items.q: How can I become a supplier?
items.a: Farmers, FPOs, processors and aggregators can register their product and capacity via our Become a Supplier page.

items.q: Do you work with new exporters or brokers?
items.a: Our focus is direct sourcing relationships and direct buyer relationships; reach out via Contact if you'd like to discuss a specific opportunity.
